script.welcome: PAM. ON YOUR MARK. TODAY IS IRON HOUR. WE WORK CLEAN AND WE WORK HARD.
script.setDone: SET IN THE BANK. STAY SHARP.
script.lastSet: LAST SET. MAKE IT THE BEST ONE.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: HEELS IN. RIBS DOWN. PAUSE AT THE TOP.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. THREE SETS OF TWELVE. PAUSE AT THE TOP. NO RIB FLARE.
exercises.speakRest: FORTY SECONDS. KEEP THE GLUTES AWAKE.

exercises.name: BODYWEIGHT SQUAT
exercises.cue: HEELS DOWN. CHEST UP. OWN THE BOTTOM.
exercises.speakStart: SQUATS. THREE SETS OF TWELVE. HEELS DOWN. DEPTH YOU CAN CONTROL.

exercises.name: WALKING LUNGE
exercises.cue: LONG STEP. UPRIGHT TORSO. PUSH THE FRONT HEEL.
exercises.speakStart: WALKING LUNGES. THREE SETS. EIGHT EACH LEG. LONG STEP. UPRIGHT TORSO.

exercises.name: PUSH-UPS
exercises.cue: STRONG PLANK. FULL RANGE. KNEES IF THE LINE BREAKS.
exercises.speakStart: PUSH-UPS. THREE SETS. EIGHT TO TWELVE. KEEP A STRONG PLANK. QUALITY OVER EGO.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: LOW BACK PINNED. SLOW. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUGS. THREE SETS. EIGHT EACH SIDE. LOW BACK PINNED TO THE DECK. SLOW.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. DO NOT RUSH THE NEXT ONE.

exercises.name: STEP-UP
exercises.cue: WHOLE FOOT ON THE BOX. DRIVE THE HEEL. STAND TALL.
exercises.speakStart: STEP-UPS. THREE SETS. EIGHT EACH LEG. DRIVE THE HEEL. NO PUSH-OFF FROM THE BACK FOOT.
exercises.speakRest: FORTY. THAT BOX IS NOT GOING TO CLIMB ITSELF.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: HIPS HIGH. STACK THE FEET. LONG NECK.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANKS. THREE ROUNDS. TWENTY FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. HIPS HIGH.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS COMPLETE. THAT IS THE SESSION.
